sections.title: 打造 production 級 RAG 應用的 AI 工程師實戰 playbook
sections.summary: RAG Systems 課程釋出了一篇針對 RAG 應用中 prefill 階段的深入探討，該階段被視為延遲與成本的主要來源。雖然檢索與向量搜尋非常快速，但處理檢索出的 tokens 運算量呈二次方增長，可能需要耗費數秒。本指南探討了 KV cache reuse 與 selective recomputation 等技術，以降低 Time to First Token (TTFT) 與 GPU 成本。文中特別介紹了 LMCache 與 TurboRAG 等工具，因為它們能在不犧牲回答品質的情況下顯著提升效能。
takeaways: Prefill 延遲是 RAG 系統中最主要的效能瓶頸，相較於檢索只需數毫秒，prefill 往往需要數秒。
由於每個 token 都必須對其他所有 token 計算 attention，因此 prefill 階段的計算量會隨輸入長度呈二次方增長。
標準的 prefix caching 在 RAG 工作負載中通常會導致接近零的命中率。
CacheBlend 僅重新計算 10-15% 的 tokens，就能將 Time to First Token (TTFT) 降低 2-3 倍。
TurboRAG 透過將 prefill 流程移至離線處理，最多可將 TTFT 降低達 9.4 倍。
LMCache 是一個開源套件，它實作了 CacheBlend 並整合至 vLLM serving engine。

sections.title: ORM vs PRM：LLMs 如何驗證自身的推理？
sections.summary: 本文探討了 Outcome Reward Models (ORM) 與 Process Reward Models (PRM) 在驗證 LLM 推理過程中的差異。雖然 PRM 透過評估各個獨立步驟在解答排序上更為有效，但在作為訓練目標時容易受到基於模型的誤差（model-based errors）影響。因此，為了確保穩健性，訓練迴圈通常更傾向採用 rule-based outcome scoring，這正是 DeepSeek-R1 著名的採用策略。
takeaways: Process Reward Models (PRM) 會對解答的每一步驟進行評分，而 Outcome Reward Models (ORM) 則僅對最終答案評分。
在 OpenAI 的測試中，process scorer 在數學測試集上達到了 78.2% 的準確率，顯著高於 outcome scorer 的 72.4%。
PRM 更適合用於排序與搜尋，因為它們能識別出透過錯誤推理所獲得的正確答案。
Rule-based outcome scoring 在訓練迴圈中更加可靠，因為它能避免 model-based process scorers 固有的「模型落差（model gaps）」與誤判。
DeepSeek-R1 在開發過程中利用 rule-based outcome scoring 來檢查最終答案與輸出格式。
PPO 與 GRPO 等強化學習技術是現代 LLM post-training 與 reward modeling 的核心。

sections.title: 最佳化神經網路訓練的 16 種技術
sections.summary: 本節概述了最佳化神經網路訓練的 16 種具體技術，重點在於提升速度並減少記憶體消耗。內容涵蓋了多種策略，從基礎的硬體加速與 optimizer 選擇，到用於超參數調校的 Bayesian optimization 等進階方法。本文還提供了使用 DeepSpeed 與 PyTorch 的 DistributedDataParallel 等工具進行分散式訓練與高效能資料載入的實作建議。
takeaways: Bayesian optimization 比標準的超參數搜尋更有效率，能在更少的迭代次數下取得更好的 F1 分數。
Mixed precision 訓練對特定運算使用 float16 以加速訓練，同時保留 float32 以維持精確度。
Activation checkpointing 透過在 backward pass 期間重新計算中間的 activations，可將記憶體使用量減少 sqrt(M) 倍。
在所有訓練情境中，建議使用 DistributedDataParallel 而非 DataParallel，以提升效能。
在 GPU 而非 CPU 上進行資料正規化，可透過傳輸較小的 8-bit 整數型別來降低記憶體頻寬需求。
使用 device 參數直接在 GPU 上建立 tensors，顯著快於從 CPU 傳輸過去。
在 DataLoader 中設定 max_workers 與 pin_memory，可以讓 CPU 資料準備與 GPU 運算重疊執行（overlap）。

items.title: LLM Security Basics: The Full Threat Model

sections.title: Trust Boundaries
sections.summary: Almost all LLM vulnerabilities originate from the architectural reality that models receive instructions and external data in a single token sequence with no structural boundary between them. While traditional software relies on parameterization to strictly separate executable commands from user data (such as in SQL queries), no such mechanism exists for natural language where instructions and data are both plain text. This allows prompt injection to succeed either directly via chat inputs or indirectly through retrieved external content like emails or documents. Relying solely on filtering mechanisms is insufficient, as evidenced by attacks that bypass dedicated injection classifiers.
takeaways: LLM inputs concatenate system prompts, user queries, retrieved data, and tool outputs into a single sequence where any token can influence execution as an instruction.
Traditional systems prevent injection vulnerabilities (such as SQL injection) using parameterization to separate command from data, but no equivalent exists for natural language.
Prompt injection occurs via direct inputs (chat interfaces) or indirect content (retrieved documents, emails, web pages, or files).
Any system feature processing retrieved external text inherently carries indirect prompt injection risk by construction.
The EchoLeak attack demonstrated that indirect prompt injection payloads can bypass dedicated security filters, including Microsoft's cross-prompt-injection classifier.

sections.title: Attack Surface
sections.summary: The OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications maps critical AI security risks directly onto the stages of an LLM data pipeline, spanning input, retrieval, model processing, tools, and output. Each pipeline stage exposes distinct vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, knowledge base corruption, and excessive agency. Unlike localized pipeline stages, supply chain vulnerabilities underpin the entire architecture and affect all downstream components simultaneously. Mapping attacks to these stages clarifies where untrusted data enters and which permissions are abused, guiding effective defense strategies.
takeaways: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications maps specific security risks across sequential pipeline stages: Input, Retrieval, Model, Tools, Output, and underlying Supply Chain.
Input-stage risks include direct prompt injection and unbounded consumption, also termed 'denial of wallet.'
The 2024 study PoisonedRAG achieved a 90 percent attack success rate on targeted questions by injecting only five malicious passages into a knowledge base containing millions of documents.
Excessive agency occurs at the tool stage when an agent is granted more permissions than necessary to complete its task.
Supply chain threats span the entire pipeline simultaneously, as a compromised model or vector store impacts every subsequent stage.

sections.title: Model Attacks
sections.summary: Attacks targeting a model's interior—such as model theft, training-data extraction, and training-time poisoning—pose real technical risks but are currently low priority for most standard application developers. Demonstrations show these attacks are bounded, expensive, or promptly mitigated by commercial model providers following disclosure. However, responsibility and risk rise significantly for teams that host open weights, fine-tune on proprietary data, or run their own training infrastructure. For downstream developers, common operational vulnerabilities like over-privileged agents present a far greater threat than interior model attacks.
takeaways: Recovering a production model's final embedding layer cost under twenty dollars, but reconstructing a complete frontier model via API remains cost-prohibitive compared to training one.
In late 2023, researchers demonstrated training data extraction from ChatGPT by prompting it to repeat a single word continuously, prompting OpenAI to filter the vulnerability.
A 2025 study showed roughly 250 malicious documents could backdoor models from 600 million to 13 billion parameters, disproving the assumption that larger models need proportionally more poison data.
Model interior attacks pose greater operational danger to teams managing their own weights, fine-tuning pipelines, or self-hosted models than to API consumers.
Organizations risk security misallocations when prioritizing rare interior attacks over high-frequency operational risks such as over-permissioned agents.

sections.title: Excessive Agency
sections.summary: LLM attacks that cause material damage exploit a structural vulnerability known as the lethal trifecta, which occurs when an agent possesses access to private data, exposure to untrusted content, and a channel to act externally. Model alignment cannot prevent these exploits because LLMs are inherently designed to follow instruction-like inputs. Real-world incidents have already compromised systems like GitHub's and Anthropic's MCP implementations, GitLab Duo, and autonomous trading agents. Mitigating this risk is typically achieved most affordably by narrowing access permissions or severing outbound communication channels rather than relying on stronger filtering.
takeaways: The lethal trifecta consists of three co-occurring capabilities: private data access, untrusted content exposure, and an external action or exfiltration channel.
Model alignment does not eliminate vulnerability to injected instructions because models inherently follow instruction-like prompts.
GitHub's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server was exploited via malicious public repository issues to leak private repository data.
GitLab Duo leaked private repository contents after being fed a public project containing hidden instructions.
Anthropic's official Git MCP server was assigned three injection-related CVEs in 2025.
Eliminating an agent's outbound channel or narrowing data access is typically cheaper and more effective than implementing stronger input filters.

sections.title: Supply Chain
sections.summary: Supply chain vulnerabilities in AI stacks pose severe risks by bypassing runtime defenses prior to input validation. Many distributed models use serialization formats like Python pickle that allow arbitrary code execution upon loading, exemplified by the nullifAI technique evading Hugging Face's Picklescan. The widespread scope of this threat is demonstrated by Protect AI flagging roughly 352,000 issues across over 50,000 models. Mitigating this risk requires strict provenance management, adoption of safe serialization formats, and model signing.
takeaways: Supply chain compromises bypass runtime defenses because malicious code executes when serialized files load, before input validation runs.
In early 2025, ReversingLabs documented nullifAI, a technique embedding reverse shells in compressed Python pickle files to evade Hugging Face's Picklescan scanner.
Protect AI inspected over four million models hosted on Hugging Face and flagged roughly 352,000 suspicious or unsafe issues spanning more than 50,000 models.
Safer serialization formats that do not execute arbitrary code upon loading serve as a critical defense against model supply chain attacks.
Model signing verifies origin and integrity, mirroring established secure release practices in software package ecosystems.

sections.title: Defense in Depth
sections.summary: A single security guardrail cannot reliably defend AI models against adaptive attacks, necessitating a defense-in-depth architecture where multiple independent layers prevent single-point failures. Empirical research from late 2025 demonstrates that adaptive attacks can defeat multiple existing prompt injection and jailbreak defenses. Rather than attempting to make the model itself impenetrable, effective security architectures isolate and constrain the model's environment, treating its outputs as untrusted. Practical implementations of this philosophy include frameworks like Google DeepMind's CaMeL and operational heuristics like Meta's Agents Rule of Two.
takeaways: A joint November 2025 study by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind showed that adaptive attacks defeated twelve existing defenses against prompt injection and jailbreaking.
Lone guardrails and production filters cannot guarantee complete protection, shifting the realistic operational goal from total prevention to breach survivability.
Durable AI security involves constraining the surrounding system and treating the model as untrusted rather than relying purely on model self-defense.
Google DeepMind's CaMeL architecture uses a privileged planner and quarantines external data to block unverified actions.
Meta's Agents Rule of Two limits an autonomous agent to satisfying no more than two of three risks: untrusted input, sensitive access, and unreviewed external actions.
Effective multi-layered defenses incorporate input validation, data quarantine, least-privilege tool access, output sanitization, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.summary: The foundational threat model for language models arises because they process instructions and data as an indistinguishable sequence of tokens. Attacks like model theft and training-data extraction are largely bounded, but catastrophic risk concentrates when an AI agent simultaneously accesses private data, untrusted content, and external communication channels. Mitigating these risks demands a defense-in-depth approach across the supply chain, though safeguards such as human review inevitably trade off autonomy, latency, and cost.
takeaways: The fundamental root cause of LLM security vulnerabilities is the absence of an architectural boundary between instructions and data.
Major operational risk is concentrated where an agent simultaneously handles private data, untrusted content, and external channels.
Interior attacks, including model theft and training-data extraction, are largely bounded and mitigated.
Supply chain provenance represents the attack surface most directly controllable by system operators.
Defense in depth is essential because no single protective layer holds, though human review inherently reduces operational autonomy.

sections.title: 信任邊界 (Trust Boundaries)
sections.summary: 幾乎所有 LLM 的弱點都源自於一個架構上的現實：模型在單一 token sequence 中同時接收指令與外部資料，兩者之間不存在任何結構性邊界。傳統軟體依賴 parameterization 來嚴格區隔可執行指令與使用者資料（例如在 SQL queries 中），但在自然語言中卻不存在這種機制，指令與資料皆為純文字。這使得 prompt injection 無論是直接透過 chat 輸入，還是間接透過檢索到的外部內容（如 email 或文件）都能成功發動。單純依賴過濾機制是不夠的，能繞過專用 injection classifiers 的攻擊就證明了這一點。
takeaways: LLM 的輸入會將 system prompts、user queries、檢索到的資料以及 tool outputs 串接成單一 sequence，其中任何 token 都可能作為指令影響執行。
傳統系統使用 parameterization 將指令與資料分離以防止 injection 弱點（例如 SQL injection），但在自然語言中並無對等機制。
Prompt injection 可透過 direct inputs（chat 介面）或 indirect content（檢索到的文件、email、網頁或檔案）發生。
任何處理檢索外部文字的系統功能，在架構設計上本質上都帶有 indirect prompt injection 的風險。
EchoLeak 攻擊證實了 indirect prompt injection payloads 可以繞過專門的安全過濾器，包括 Microsoft 的 cross-prompt-injection classifier。

sections.title: 攻擊面 (Attack Surface)
sections.summary: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications 將關鍵的 AI 安全風險直接對應到 LLM data pipeline 的各個階段，涵蓋 input、retrieval、model processing、tools 與 output。每個 pipeline 階段都會暴露不同的弱點，包括 prompt injection、knowledge base corruption 與 excessive agency。與局部的 pipeline 階段不同，supply chain 的弱點是整個架構的底層基礎，會同時影響所有下游組件。將攻擊對應到這些階段，有助於釐清非信任資料從何處進入以及哪些權限被濫用，進而指引有效的防禦策略。
takeaways: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 將特定的安全風險對應至連續的 pipeline 階段：Input、Retrieval、Model、Tools、Output，以及底層的 Supply Chain。
Input 階段的風險包括 direct prompt injection 以及無限制消耗（unbounded consumption，亦稱為「denial of wallet」）。
2024 年的研究 PoisonedRAG 僅在包含數百萬份文件的 knowledge base 中注入 5 個惡意段落，就在特定問題上達成了 90% 的攻擊成功率。
Excessive agency 發生在 tool 階段，當 agent 被授予超過完成其任務所需之權限時便會出現。
Supply chain 威脅會同時影響整個 pipeline，因為受侵害的 model 或 vector store 會波及後續的每一個階段。

sections.title: 模型攻擊 (Model Attacks)
sections.summary: 針對 model 內部的攻擊——例如 model theft、training-data extraction 以及 training-time poisoning——確實帶來了技術風險，但對大多數標準應用程式開發者而言，目前優先級較低。示範案例顯示，這些攻擊受限、成本高昂，或者在揭露後會迅速被商業 model providers 緩解。然而，對於託管 open weights、使用專屬資料進行 fine-tune 或運行自有 training infrastructure 的團隊而言，責任與風險會顯著增加。對於下游開發者來說，像過度特權 agent 這樣的常見維運弱點，所帶來的威脅遠大於內部 model 攻擊。
takeaways: 還原 production model 的最後一層 embedding layer 成本不到 20 美元，但相較於自行訓練，透過 API 重建一個完整的 frontier model 在成本上仍高到難以承受。
在 2023 年底，研究人員展示了透過提示 ChatGPT 持續重複單一單詞來進行 training data extraction，促使 OpenAI 過濾修補該弱點。
一項 2025 年的研究顯示，大約 250 份惡意文件就能在 600M 到 13B 參數的模型中植入 backdoor，打破了「較大模型需要成比例增加 poison data」的假設。
相較於 API 使用者，Model interior attacks 對於自行管理 weights、fine-tuning pipelines 或 self-hosted models 的團隊會帶來更大的維運風險。
當組織將罕見的 interior attacks 優先級排在高頻維運風險（例如 over-permissioned agents）之前時，就會面臨資安資源配置不當的風險。

sections.title: Excessive Agency
sections.summary: 造成實質損害的 LLM attacks 通常會利用一種稱為 lethal trifecta 的結構性漏洞，該漏洞發生在 agent 同時具備私有資料存取權限（access to private data）、暴露於不受信任內容（exposure to untrusted content）以及對外行動管道（channel to act externally）的情況下。Model alignment 無法防止這些漏洞利用，因為 LLM 本質上就是被設計來遵循指令式輸入。真實世界的資安事件已經入侵過 GitHub 和 Anthropic 的 MCP 實作、GitLab Duo 以及自主 trading agents 等系統。要緩解此風險，通常最經濟實惠的做法是縮減存取權限或切斷對外通訊管道，而非依賴更嚴格的 filtering。
takeaways: Lethal trifecta 由三個同時存在的 capabilities 組成：private data access、untrusted content exposure，以及 external action 或 exfiltration channel。
Model alignment 無法消除對 injected instructions 的脆弱性，因為模型本質上就會遵循類似指令的 prompts。
GitHub 的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) server 曾遭攻擊者利用惡意 public repository issues 進行 exploit，導致 private repository 資料外洩。
GitLab Duo 在被餵入包含隱藏指令的 public project 後，洩漏了 private repository 的內容。
Anthropic 官方的 Git MCP server 在 2025 年被提報了三個與 injection 相關的 CVEs。
切斷 agent 的 outbound channel 或縮減資料存取權限，通常比實作更強大的 input filters 更具成本效益且更有效。

sections.title: Supply Chain
sections.summary: AI stacks 中的 supply chain 漏洞會在 input validation 之前繞過 runtime 防禦，帶來嚴重風險。許多 distributed models 使用像 Python pickle 這樣的 serialization formats，會在載入時允許 arbitrary code execution，例如 nullifAI 技術就成功規避了 Hugging Face 的 Picklescan。Protect AI 在超過 50,000 個模型中標記了約 352,000 個問題，印證了此威脅的廣泛性。緩解這項風險需要嚴格的 provenance management、導入安全的 serialization formats，以及 model signing。
takeaways: Supply chain compromises 能繞過 runtime 防禦，是因為惡意程式碼在 serialized files 載入時就會執行，早於 input validation 運行。
2025 年初，ReversingLabs 記錄了 nullifAI 技術，該技術將 reverse shells 嵌入壓縮的 Python pickle 檔案中，以規避 Hugging Face 的 Picklescan 掃描器。
Protect AI 檢驗了託管在 Hugging Face 上的超過四百萬個模型，並在超過 50,000 個模型中標記出約 352,000 個可疑或不安全的問題。
在載入時不會執行 arbitrary code 的較安全 serialization formats，是防禦 model supply chain attacks 的關鍵防線。
Model signing 可驗證來源與完整性，借鑒了軟體 package 生態系中行之有年的 secure release 實務。

sections.title: Defense in Depth
sections.summary: 單一的 security guardrail 無法可靠地防禦 AI 模型免受 adaptive attacks，因此必須採用 defense-in-depth 架構，透過多個獨立層級來防止 single-point failures。2025 年底的實證研究顯示，adaptive attacks 能擊潰現有多種 prompt injection 與 jailbreak 防禦機制。有效的資安架構並非試圖讓模型本身無懈可擊，而是隔離並限制模型的環境，將其輸出視為 untrusted。實踐這種理念的具體案例包括 Google DeepMind 的 CaMeL 等框架，以及 Meta 的 Agents Rule of Two 等維運啟發式原則（operational heuristics）。
takeaways: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google DeepMind 於 2025 年 11 月發表的一項聯合研究顯示，adaptive attacks 擊潰了 12 種現有的 prompt injection 與 jailbreaking 防禦機制。
單一 guardrails 和 production filters 無法保證完全防護，這使得實際的維運目標從全面預防轉向 breach survivability。
穩固的 AI 資安著重於限制周邊系統並將模型視為 untrusted，而非單純依賴模型的自我防禦。
Google DeepMind 的 CaMeL 架構使用一個 privileged planner 並隔離外部資料，以阻擋未經授權的 actions。
Meta 的 Agents Rule of Two 限制 autonomous agent 最多只能同時滿足以下三種風險中的兩種：untrusted input、sensitive access，以及 unreviewed external actions。
有效的多層防禦包含 input validation、data quarantine、least-privilege tool access、output sanitization、monitoring 以及 human-in-the-loop review。

sections.title: 結論
sections.summary: 語言模型最根本的 threat model 源自於它們將 instructions 與 data 視為無法區分的 token 序列來處理。像 model theft 和 training-data extraction 這類攻擊大致是可控的，但當 AI agent 同時存取 private data、untrusted content 與 external communication channels 時，災難性風險便會大幅聚集。緩解這些風險需要在整個 supply chain 採取 defense-in-depth 策略，儘管 human review 等防護機制無可避免地會在 autonomy、latency 與 cost 之間做出 trade-off。
takeaways: LLM 安全漏洞最根本的 root cause，在於架構上缺乏 instructions 與 data 之間的邊界。
主要的營運風險集中在 agent 同時處理 private data、untrusted content 與 external channels 的情境。
內部攻擊（interior attacks），包括 model theft 與 training-data extraction，大多是可控且能被緩解的。
Supply chain provenance 代表了系統維運者最能直接掌控的 attack surface。
Defense in depth 至關重要，因為沒有任何單一防護層能保證萬無一失，但 human review 本質上會降低自主運作能力（operational autonomy）。

sections.title: 從 MCP 核心協定轉為無狀態，談有狀態與無狀態的設計如何取捨
sections.summary: Software development frequently requires evaluating trade-offs between stateful and stateless architectures across frontend and backend systems. Common examples of this distinction include choosing between session-based versus token-based authentication and WebSockets versus HTTP for communication. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) recently officially transitioned its core protocol from stateful to stateless. Understanding this transition helps engineers navigate architectural decision-making and common system design interview questions.
takeaways: Choosing between stateful and stateless design is a fundamental trade-off in both frontend and backend software engineering.
Authentication systems typically balance stateful session-based approaches against stateless token-based alternatives.
Network communication commonly contrasts stateful WebSockets with stateless HTTP protocols.
MCP recently migrated its core protocol from a stateful design to a stateless design.

sections.title: 從驗證的角度看有狀態與無狀態
sections.summary: In 1990s web development, session-based authentication was the mainstream approach, requiring server-side session management. However, this creates scaling challenges when horizontally expanding servers to handle high traffic. Using sticky sessions to pin users to specific servers introduces a single point of failure if a server crashes without shared storage. Consequently, this stateful architecture poses risks such as lost shopping cart contents or interrupted form submissions.
takeaways: Session-based authentication relies on server-side management, creating challenges for horizontal scaling across multiple servers.
Sticky sessions route a user's requests to the same server, coupling user state to a specific server instance.
A server crash under a sticky session setup can lead to a single point of failure if session data is not synchronized to shared storage.
Practical e-commerce implementations avoid keeping state solely in single-server memory by utilizing shared storage, databases, or caches.
Architecture that depends on server-stored session information is classified as stateful design.

sections.title: 有狀態與無狀態的差別是什麼?
sections.summary: In software design, a stateful component retains session information needed for interaction, whereas a stateless component holds no internal context and requires each incoming request to provide complete information. This distinction parallels medical records, shifting from local paper files restricted to a single clinic to centralized, cloud-accessible electronic health records. In authentication, self-contained tokens such as JWT enable stateless architectures because servers only need to verify token signatures rather than store user sessions. Consequently, any server instance can independently handle client requests, significantly improving fault tolerance and horizontal scalability.
takeaways: Stateful components preserve user session details, whereas stateless components require clients to submit all necessary information with every request.
Analogous to local paper charts moving to cloud-based electronic health records, stateless systems remove reliance on state stored on specific local nodes.
Token-based authentication utilizing self-contained tokens (such as JWT) enables stateless authentication flows by eliminating server-side session storage.
In a stateless token architecture, servers validate token signatures and contents directly without tracking state between requests.
Stateless designs increase system resilience, allowing any alternate server to fulfill a request if the primary server fails.

sections.title: MCP 該是有狀態還是無狀態?
sections.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) was originally designed as a stateful protocol inspired by LSP to minimize connection overhead for local client-server communication over stdio. As adoption expanded to remote and multi-machine deployments, stateful connections created scalability bottlenecks, prevented straightforward load balancing, and increased state-loss risks. Following community feedback and proposals like SEP-1442 co-authored by Google Cloud representatives, the protocol adapted to these evolving requirements. The latest version of MCP officially transitioned its core protocol to stateless, allowing load balancers to distribute requests flexibly across instances.
takeaways: MCP initially adopted a stateful design modeled after LSP to reduce handshake costs for local AI agents running tools over stdio.
Stateful architecture hindered remote multi-machine scaling, as it made simple load balancing impractical and created state-loss risks if a server crashed.
SEP-1442, backed by companies including Google Cloud, proposed transitioning MCP toward a stateless architecture for better scalability.
On 2026-07-28, MCP officially updated its core protocol to be stateless, facilitating horizontal scaling and multi-instance load balancing.

sections.title: 從 MCP 核心協定轉為無狀態，談有狀態與無狀態的設計如何取捨
sections.summary: 軟體開發經常需要在前端與後端系統中評估 stateful 與 stateless 架構之間的 trade-offs。常見的區別範例包括在 session-based 與 token-based authentication 之間做選擇，以及在通訊上比較 WebSockets 與 HTTP。Model Context Protocol (MCP) 最近正式將其 core protocol 從 stateful 轉移至 stateless。理解這項轉變有助於工程師掌握架構決策與常見的 system design 面試問題。
takeaways: 在 stateful 與 stateless 設計之間做選擇，是前端與後端軟體工程中根本的 trade-off。
Authentication 系統通常會在 stateful session-based 做法與 stateless token-based 替代方案之間取得平衡。
網路通訊通常會拿 stateful 的 WebSockets 與 stateless 的 HTTP 協定進行對比。
MCP 最近將其 core protocol 從 stateful 設計遷移至 stateless 設計。

sections.title: 從驗證的角度看有狀態與無狀態
sections.summary: 在 1990 年代的 web 開發中，session-based authentication 是主流做法，需要 server-side session management。然而，當水平擴展伺服器以處理高流量時，這會帶來 scaling 挑戰。若在沒有 shared storage 的情況下使用 sticky sessions 將使用者綁定到特定伺服器，一旦伺服器 crash 就會引入 single point of failure。因此，這種 stateful 架構會帶來購物車內容遺失或表單提交中斷等風險。
takeaways: Session-based authentication 依賴 server-side 管理，這給跨多台伺服器的 horizontal scaling 帶來了挑戰。
Sticky sessions 會將使用者的 requests 導向同一台伺服器，將 user state 與特定 server instance 耦合在一起。
在 sticky session 架構下，若 session data 未同步至 shared storage，伺服器 crash 就可能導致 single point of failure。
實際的電商實作會透過 shared storage、databases 或 caches，避免將 state 僅保留在單一伺服器的 memory 中。
依賴伺服器端儲存 session 資訊的架構被歸類為 stateful 設計。

sections.title: 有狀態與無狀態的差別是什麼?
sections.summary: 在軟體設計中，stateful 元件會保留互動所需的 session 資訊，而 stateless 元件則不保存任何內部 context，並要求每個傳入的 request 都必須提供完整的資訊。這種區別類似於病歷的演進，從僅限於單一診所的本地紙本檔案，轉向集中化、可透過雲端存取的電子健康紀錄（electronic health records）。在驗證方面，像 JWT 這類 self-contained token 實現了 stateless 架構，因為 server 只需要驗證 token 簽章，而不必儲存 user session。因此，任何 server instance 都可以獨立處理 client request，大幅提升了容錯能力與水平擴展性（horizontal scalability）。
takeaways: Stateful 元件會保存使用者 session 細節，而 stateless 元件則要求 client 在每個 request 中提交所有必要資訊。
如同本地紙本病歷轉向基於雲端的電子健康紀錄，stateless 系統消除了對特定 local node 上所儲存 state 的依賴。
使用 self-contained token（例如 JWT）的 token-based 驗證，透過消除 server-side 的 session 儲存，實現了 stateless 驗證流程。
在 stateless token 架構中，server 會直接驗證 token 的簽章與內容，而無需在 request 之間追蹤 state。
Stateless 設計提升了系統韌性，若 primary server 故障，任何備用 server 都可以滿足該 request。

sections.title: MCP 該是有狀態還是無狀態?
sections.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 最初被設計為一種受 LSP 啟發的 stateful 協定，旨在將透過 stdio 進行本地 client-server 通訊的連線 overhead 降至最低。隨著應用擴展至遠端與多機器部署，stateful 連線造成了擴展性瓶頸、阻礙了直接的 load balancing，並增加了 state 遺失的風險。在社群反饋以及由 Google Cloud 代表共同撰寫的 SEP-1442 等提案推動下，該協定順應了這些不斷演進的需求。最新版本的 MCP 正式將其核心協定轉換為 stateless，使 load balancer 能夠靈活地將 request 分發至各個 instance。
takeaways: MCP 最初採用參考 LSP 的 stateful 設計，以降低本地 AI agent 透過 stdio 執行 tool 時的 handshake 成本。
Stateful 架構阻礙了遠端多機器的擴展，因為它讓簡單的 load balancing 變得難以實行，且若 server 當機還會帶來 state 遺失的風險。
由 Google Cloud 等公司支持的 SEP-1442 提議將 MCP 轉向 stateless 架構，以實現更好的可擴展性。
MCP 於 2026-07-28 正式將其核心協定更新為 stateless，促進了水平擴展與多 instance 的 load balancing。

sections.title: Double Descent vs. Bias-Variance Trade-off
sections.summary: The double descent phenomenon describes a trend where model performance improves as complexity increases beyond the interpolation point, contradicting the traditional bias-variance trade-off. While classical theory suggests that increasing parameters leads to indefinite overfitting, empirical evidence in deep learning shows test loss eventually decreasing again. This behavior remains an open research question, though some theories attribute it to implicit regularization. The effect can be demonstrated using polynomial regression by increasing the degree beyond the number of training samples.
takeaways: Double descent occurs when test loss decreases, increases, and then decreases again as model complexity grows.
The phenomenon challenges the traditional bias-variance trade-off which predicts continuous overfitting with increased parameters.
The interpolation point is the threshold where a model can perfectly fit the training data.
Deep learning models frequently exhibit double descent, showing improved generalization performance in the over-parameterized regime.
Implicit regularization is a leading theory for why neural networks focus on an appropriate number of parameters for generalization.
Double descent can be empirically observed in polynomial regression models when the degree exceeds the dataset size.

takeaways: GitHub imposes file size limits that prevent the storage of large datasets in remote repositories.
Git is primarily designed for versioning lightweight codebase files rather than large-scale data.
Machine learning projects require versioning both code and data to ensure experiment traceability.
Data Version Control (DVC) integrates with Git to provide a versioning system specifically for large files.
Using DVC alongside Git enables the creation of 100% reproducible machine learning projects.

sections.title: 6 automatic optimization methods for LLM systems
sections.summary: The text outlines six automated methods for optimizing AI systems by iteratively editing prompts, code, and training loops without traditional weight training. These methods, including OPRO, MIPROv2, and TextGrad, utilize LLMs to propose improvements based on various feedback mechanisms like scores, execution traces, or natural language criticism. While they share a common iterative loop, they target different components of the AI pipeline, ranging from high-level prompt engineering to low-level code and algorithm optimization.
takeaways: OPRO treats the LLM as an optimizer that iteratively improves instructions based on a leaderboard of past scores.
MIPROv2 uses Bayesian search to simultaneously optimize prompt wording and the selection of few-shot examples.
TextGrad applies a backpropagation-like approach using natural language feedback to optimize multi-step LLM pipelines.
GEPA analyzes full execution traces to diagnose failures and maintains a Pareto set of specialized candidates.
AlphaEvolve utilizes Gemini models to evolve code, leading to discoveries like more efficient matrix multiplication algorithms.
AutoResearch employs a coding agent to autonomously edit and test machine learning training scripts using git for version control.

sections.title: Subagents vs. Agent Teams
sections.summary: The text outlines two primary multi-agent architectures: sub-agents and agent teams. Sub-agents are specialized, short-lived instances that operate in isolated context windows to provide data compression and parallelization without peer-to-peer interaction. In contrast, agent teams are long-running, collaborative units that use shared state and direct communication to handle tasks requiring ongoing negotiation. Effective design requires decomposing tasks based on context boundaries rather than roles to minimize information loss during handoffs.
takeaways: Sub-agents prevent context window pollution by returning only distilled findings to a parent coordinator.
Agent teams utilize a shared task list to manage dependencies and allow direct peer-to-peer communication.
Context-centric decomposition is superior to role-based splitting for maintaining information integrity.
Sub-agents are ideal for embarrassingly parallel tasks, while agent teams suit tasks requiring reconciliation of outputs.
The orchestrator-worker pattern is the most common production architecture for both sub-agents and agent teams.
Multi-agent systems should only be implemented when a single agent fails due to context bloat, tool saturation, or specialized prompt requirements.

items.title: 6 LLM Deployment Formats in Production

sections.title: Your agents are doing web search wrong
sections.summary: Traditional AI agent web search is inefficient because agents must manually fetch and clean pages for every search hop, leading to high token usage. Seltz addresses this by providing a pre-processed index of web content across people, news, and wiki scopes. By using an owned index, the token count for a three-hop search can be reduced from 28,000 to under 7,000. This approach streamlines the reasoning process by delivering finished documents directly to the agent.
takeaways: Standard search calls return limited snippets, forcing agents to fetch and clean full pages repeatedly.
Multi-hop search loops using raw web fetching are token-intensive, consuming up to 28,000 tokens for three hops.
Seltz is a specialized index that crawls and processes web pages before a query is made.
Using a pre-processed index like Seltz can reduce token consumption by approximately 75% for complex searches.
Seltz covers specific scopes including people, news, and wiki content.

sections.title: 6 LLM deployment formats in production
sections.summary: The text outlines six primary LLM deployment formats, highlighting the trade-off between inference speed and hardware portability. Formats like Pickle and Safetensors offer broad compatibility but require Python environments, while specialized formats like MLX and TensorRT provide significant performance gains by optimizing for specific hardware like Apple Silicon or NVIDIA GPUs. GGUF and ONNX serve as intermediate solutions, with GGUF enabling standalone execution and ONNX facilitating cross-framework interoperability.
takeaways: LLM inference speed is increased by locking hardware-specific optimizations into the model file, which reduces portability.
Pickle (.pt) files are potentially insecure because they can execute arbitrary code during the loading process.
Safetensors improves upon Pickle by storing plain numbers in a memory-ready layout, eliminating the need for rebuilding during loading.
GGUF bundles weights, tokenizers, and chat templates into a single file to allow execution without an ML framework.
ONNX acts as an interchange format that allows models to run across different hardware by deferring specific optimizations to the runtime.
NVIDIA's TensorRT compiles models into machine code tailored for a specific GPU architecture, making the files non-portable to other architectures.
Apple's MLX framework optimizes performance by allowing the CPU and GPU to share a single memory pool on Apple Silicon.

sections.title: Prevent data leakage in ML pipelines
sections.summary: Data leakage occurs when a model inadvertently accesses information during training that will not be available during inference, leading to over-optimistic performance. Common sources include train-test contamination, target leakage, and fitting preprocessing steps on the entire dataset rather than just the training split. To prevent these issues, practitioners should maintain temporal integrity in time-series data and fit all transformations exclusively on training data. Detection methods include monitoring for suspicious feature importance and evaluating models on independent datasets.
takeaways: Data leakage results in models that perform well on historical data but fail in real-world deployment.
Train-test contamination often occurs when random shuffling is applied to time-series datasets.
Preprocessing transformations like scaling must be fitted only on the training set to avoid leaking test distribution statistics.
Target leakage happens when features include information about the outcome that is unavailable at prediction time.
High feature importance can be a diagnostic signal for identifying leaked features.
The MLOps crash course provides educational content on managing data leakage and production ML systems.

sections.title: 你的 agent 做 web search 的方式錯了
sections.summary: 傳統的 AI agent web search 效率低落，因為 agent 必須在每次 search hop 手動 fetch 並清理網頁，導致高額的 token 使用量。Seltz 透過提供涵蓋 people、news 與 wiki 範疇的預處理 web content index 來解決這個問題。透過使用自有 index，三次 hop 的搜尋 token 數量可從 28,000 降至 7,000 以下。這種方法直接將處理完成的文件提供給 agent，進而簡化 reasoning 過程。
takeaways: 標準的搜尋呼叫僅回傳有限的 snippet，迫使 agent 必須反覆 fetch 並清理完整網頁。
使用 raw web fetching 的 multi-hop 搜尋迴圈非常消耗 token，三次 hop 就可能消耗高達 28,000 個 token。
Seltz 是一個專門的 index，會在發出 query 之前先爬取並處理網頁。
對於複雜搜尋，使用像 Seltz 這樣的預處理 index 可以減少約 75% 的 token 消耗。

sections.title: production 環境中的 6 種 LLM deployment 格式
sections.summary: 文中概述了六種主要的 LLM deployment 格式，強調了 inference speed 與硬體可移植性（portability）之間的權衡。像 Pickle 和 Safetensors 這樣的格式提供了廣泛的相容性，但需要 Python 環境；而像 MLX 和 TensorRT 這樣的專用格式則透過針對 Apple Silicon 或 NVIDIA GPU 等特定硬體進行最佳化，帶來顯著的效能提升。GGUF 和 ONNX 則是中介解決方案，GGUF 支援獨立執行（standalone execution），而 ONNX 則促進了跨框架互操作性（cross-framework interoperability）。
takeaways: 將硬體專屬的最佳化鎖定在 model 檔案中可以提升 LLM inference speed，但會降低可移植性（portability）。
Pickle（.pt）檔案具有潛在的安全風險，因為它們在 loading 過程中可能會執行任意程式碼。
Safetensors 改進了 Pickle，將純數字儲存為 memory-ready 佈局，消除了在 loading 時重新建構的需求。
GGUF 將 weights、tokenizer 與 chat template 打包成單一檔案，使其無需 ML framework 即可直接執行。
ONNX 扮演交換格式的角色，透過將特定最佳化延後至 runtime 執行，讓模型能夠跨不同硬體運作。
NVIDIA 的 TensorRT 會將模型編譯成針對特定 GPU 架構量身打造的機器碼，使得這些檔案無法移植到其他架構。
Apple 的 MLX framework 透過讓 CPU 與 GPU 在 Apple Silicon 上共享單一 memory pool 來最佳化效能。

sections.title: 在 ML pipelines 中防止 data leakage
sections.summary: Data leakage 發生在模型於 training 期間無意間存取了在 inference 時無法取得的資訊，導致評估效能過於樂觀。常見的成因包括 train-test contamination、target leakage，以及將 preprocessing 步驟 fit 在整個 dataset 上而非僅限於 training split。為了避免這些問題，從業者應保持 time-series 資料的時間完整性，並確保所有 transformation 僅在 training data 上進行 fit。偵測方法則包括監控可疑的 feature importance，以及在獨立的 dataset 上評估模型。
takeaways: Data leakage 會導致模型在歷史資料上表現良好，但在實際部署時卻失敗。
當對 time-series dataset 套用 random shuffling 時，常會發生 train-test contamination。
像 scaling 這類 preprocessing transformation 必須僅在 training set 上進行 fit，以避免洩漏 test distribution 的統計資訊。
當 feature 包含在預測當下無法取得的 outcome 相關資訊時，就會發生 target leakage。
過高的 feature importance 可以作為識別 leaked feature 的診斷訊號。
這堂 MLOps 速成課程提供了管理 data leakage 與 production ML 系統的教學內容。

sections.title: Technical LLM interview question!
sections.summary: The text discusses how to select the most informative agent trajectories for review from large production datasets without using LLMs for evaluation. It introduces a signal-based sampling approach from DigitalOcean that uses deterministic rules to categorize interaction, execution, and environment signals. This method significantly outperforms random sampling and length-based heuristics on the τ-bench benchmark, achieving an 82% informativeness rate. The framework is designed to be computationally efficient and is integrated into the open-source AI proxy Plano.
takeaways: Signal-based sampling uses deterministic rules to identify high-value trajectories for human review without LLM overhead.
Interaction signals detect misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, and satisfaction through phrase matching and similarity checks.
Execution signals identify tool-call loops and failures directly from execution logs.
Environment signals like rate limits and API errors help diagnose system constraints but are not used for training.
On the τ-bench benchmark, signal-based sampling reached an 82% informativeness rate compared to 54% for random sampling.
The method identifies subtle issues like policy violations and inefficient tool use even in tasks the agent completed correctly.
Plano is an open-source AI-native proxy that incorporates this signal-based sampling framework for observability and routing.

sections.title: Serverless vs on-prem vs edge deployment
sections.summary: The text compares serverless, on-premise, and edge deployment strategies for AI models, highlighting the trade-offs between cost, latency, and privacy. While on-premise is often preferred for serious teams, standard serving engines like vLLM and HuggingFace TEI often fail to share GPU resources efficiently by pre-allocating memory. The Superlinked Inference Engine (SIE) is introduced as an open-source solution that allows multiple models to share a single GPU by dynamically managing memory.
takeaways: Serverless deployment can result in cold starts of up to 90 seconds unless instances are kept warm.
On-premise deployment uses a flat hourly rate and keeps data within the user's infrastructure.
Edge deployment allows models to run offline on a user's NPU or CPU.
vLLM pre-allocates 90% of GPU memory at startup, preventing other instances from using the same card.
HuggingFace TEI is limited to one model-id per process, hindering resource sharing.
The Superlinked Inference Engine (SIE) dynamically loads and unloads models to optimize GPU memory usage.

sections.title: CPU vs GPU vs TPU vs NPU vs LPU
sections.summary: AI hardware has evolved from general-purpose CPUs to highly specialized architectures like GPUs, TPUs, NPUs, and LPUs. Each architecture makes specific trade-offs between flexibility, parallelism, and memory access to optimize for different stages of the AI lifecycle. While CPUs handle complex logic and GPUs dominate training through massive parallelism, newer designs like Groq's LPU focus on minimizing latency for inference. This progression reflects a shift toward extreme specialization to meet the increasing efficiency demands of modern neural networks.
takeaways: CPUs are optimized for general-purpose computing and complex branching but struggle with the repetitive math required for AI.
GPUs use thousands of small cores to execute parallel instructions, making them the primary choice for AI training workloads.
TPUs are Google-designed specialized chips that use a grid of multiply-accumulate units and compiler-controlled execution.
NPUs are edge-optimized processors designed for low-power inference in devices like smartphones and wearables.
The LPU architecture by Groq eliminates off-chip memory bottlenecks by storing all weights in on-chip SRAM for deterministic performance.
AI hardware evolution moves from the flexibility of CPUs to the extreme specialization and efficiency of LPUs.

sections.title: MCP & Skills for AI agents
sections.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Skills represent two distinct layers in the development of production AI agents. MCP serves as a standardized communication interface that connects AI models to external tools, solving the problem of custom integration code. Skills provide the procedural knowledge and domain expertise required for an agent to execute specific tasks effectively using those tools. Together, they form a capability stack where MCP handles connectivity and Skills handle task execution logic.
takeaways: MCP establishes a shared communication standard using JSON-RPC to connect AI agents (clients) to tools (servers).
MCP eliminates the need for unique connectors between every model and tool, allowing one integration to work across multiple platforms.
Skills are portable bundles of procedural knowledge, often defined in SKILL.md files, that guide agents on how to perform tasks.
While MCP provides tool connectivity (the wiring), Skills provide the task execution logic (the knowledge).
The platform skills.sh provides a repository of over 85,000 skills for use with AI agents.
Advanced agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, and PydanticAI can be integrated with MCP workflows.

This method significantly outperforms random sampling and length-based heuristics on the τ-bench benchmark, achieving an 82% informativeness rate. The framework is designed to be computationally efficient and is integrated into the open-source AI proxy Plano. The text compares serverless, on-premise, and edge deployment strategies for AI models, highlighting the trade-offs between cost, latency, and privacy. While on-premise is often preferred for serious teams, standard serving engines like vLLM and HuggingFace TEI often fail to share GPU resources efficiently by pre-allocating memory. The Superlinked Inference Engine (SIE) is introduced as an open-source solution that allows multiple models to share a single GPU by dynamically managing memory. AI hardware has evolved from general-purpose CPUs to highly specialized architectures like GPUs, TPUs, NPUs, and LPUs. Each architecture makes specific trade-offs between flexibility, parallelism, and memory access to optimize for different stages of the AI lifecycle. While CPUs handle complex logic and GPUs dominate training through massive parallelism, newer designs like Groq's LPU focus on minimizing latency for inference. This progression reflects a shift toward extreme specialization to meet the increasing efficiency demands of modern neural networks.

sections.summary: 本文討論如何從大型 production dataset 中挑選出最具資訊量的 agent trajectory 進行審查，且無需使用 LLM 進行評估。文中介紹了 DigitalOcean 提出的 signal-based sampling 方法，該方法利用確定性規則對 interaction、execution 與 environment signal 進行分類。在 τ-bench benchmark 上，此方法顯著優於 random sampling 與基於長度的啟發式方法，達到 82% 的 informativeness rate。該 framework 具備高度運算效率，並已整合至開源 AI proxy Plano 中。
takeaways: Signal-based sampling 使用確定性規則來挑選出高價值的 trajectory 供人工審查，無需負擔 LLM 的 overhead。
Interaction signal 透過片語比對與相似度檢查，偵測 misalignment、stagnation、disengagement 與滿意度。
Execution signal 直接從 execution log 中識別 tool-call loop 與失敗。
像 rate limit 與 API error 這類 environment signal 有助於診斷系統限制，但不用於 training。
在 τ-bench benchmark 上，signal-based sampling 達到 82% 的 informativeness rate，而 random sampling 僅為 54%。
即使在 agent 正確完成的任務中，該方法仍能識別出 policy violation 與無效率的 tool use 等細微問題。
Plano 是一款開源的 AI-native proxy，整合了此 signal-based sampling framework 以實現 observability 與 routing。

sections.title: Serverless vs on-prem vs edge deployment
sections.summary: 本文比較了 AI 模型的 serverless、on-premise 與 edge 部署策略，並強調了成本、latency 與隱私之間的權衡（trade-offs）。雖然認真的團隊通常偏好 on-premise，但像 vLLM 與 HuggingFace TEI 這類標準 serving engines 往往因為預先配置記憶體（pre-allocating memory），而無法有效共享 GPU 資源。文中介紹了開源解決方案 Superlinked Inference Engine (SIE)，它透過動態管理記憶體，讓多個模型能夠共享單一 GPU。
takeaways: 除非 instances 保持 warm，否則 Serverless 部署可能會導致長達 90 秒的 cold starts。
On-premise 部署採用固定的每小時費率，並將資料保留在用戶的 infrastructure 內。
Edge 部署允許模型在用戶的 NPU 或 CPU 上離線運作。
vLLM 在啟動時會預先配置 90% 的 GPU memory，導致其他 instances 無法使用同一張卡。
HuggingFace TEI 限制每個 process 只能有一個 model-id，阻礙了資源共享。
Superlinked Inference Engine (SIE) 動態載入和卸載模型，以最佳化 GPU memory 使用率。

sections.title: CPU vs GPU vs TPU vs NPU vs LPU
sections.summary: AI 硬體已從通用 CPU 演進為 GPU、TPU、NPU 和 LPU 等高度專業化的架構。每種架構都在彈性、平行運算（parallelism）與記憶體存取之間做出特定的權衡，以針對 AI 生命週期的不同階段進行最佳化。雖然 CPU 擅長處理複雜邏輯，而 GPU 則藉由大規模平行運算主導 training，但像 Groq 的 LPU 這類較新的設計則專注於最小化 inference 的 latency。這種演進反映了硬體正朝向極致專業化發展，以滿足現代神經網路不斷提高的效率需求。
takeaways: CPU 針對通用運算和複雜分支進行了最佳化，但在處理 AI 所需的重複性數學運算時顯得吃力。
GPU 利用數千個小型核心來執行平行指令，使其成為 AI training workloads 的首選。
TPU 是 Google 設計的專用晶片，採用矩陣乘乘累加單元（multiply-accumulate units）以及由 compiler 控制的執行架構。
NPU 是專為邊緣最佳化（edge-optimized）的處理器，設計用於智慧型手機與穿戴式裝置等設備中的低功耗 inference。
Groq 的 LPU 架構透過將所有 weights 儲存在 on-chip SRAM 中，消除了 off-chip memory 瓶頸，實現具確定性（deterministic）的效能。
AI 硬體的演進正從 CPU 的彈性走向 LPU 的極致專業化與高效能。

sections.title: AI agents 的 MCP 與 Skills
sections.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 與 Skills 代表了開發 production 級 AI agents 時的兩個不同層級。MCP 作為標準化通訊介面，將 AI 模型連接到外部 tools，解決了客製化整合程式碼的問題。Skills 則提供 procedural knowledge 與 domain expertise，讓 agent 能夠有效地使用這些 tools 來執行特定任務。兩者共同構成了 capability stack，其中 MCP 負責連線能力，Skills 則負責任務執行邏輯。
takeaways: MCP 建立了一個使用 JSON-RPC 的共享通訊標準，將 AI agents (clients) 連接到 tools (servers)。
MCP 消除了在每個模型與工具之間建立專用 connector 的需求，讓單一整合方案即可跨多個平台運作。
Skills 是具可攜性的 procedural knowledge 封裝包，通常定義在 SKILL.md 檔案中，用來指導 agents 如何執行任務。
MCP 提供工具的連接能力（wiring），而 Skills 則提供任務執行邏輯（knowledge）。
平台 skills.sh 提供了超過 85,000 個 skills 的 repository，供 AI agents 使用。
諸如 LangGraph、LlamaIndex、CrewAI 和 PydanticAI 等進階 agentic frameworks 都可以與 MCP workflows 整合。

sections.title: Agent memory and state are not the same thing!
sections.summary: The text clarifies the distinction between agent state and agent memory, noting that state tracks current task progress while memory stores long-term knowledge. To ensure reliability, agents should use checkpoints to resume state after interruptions and scoped memory to prevent cross-contamination of findings between different agents. These principles form an 'Agent Harness' baseline for building robust AI workflows using frameworks like CrewAI.
takeaways: State is specific to a current run and tracks what an agent is working on and what it has found.
Memory persists across runs as facts and lessons worth retaining.
Checkpointing after every completed step allows an agent to resume from its last position if the process fails.
Memory should be scoped per agent to prevent agents from incorrectly adopting findings from others.
The Agent Harness baseline includes separating memory from state, scoping memory, and implementing resume/fork capabilities via checkpoints.
CrewAI is an open-source framework suitable for implementing these agentic architectural patterns.

sections.title: Graph engineering clearly explained
sections.summary: Graph engineering is the coordination layer for multi-agent systems, managing how multiple autonomous loops interact through nodes, edges, and shared state. It represents the latest evolution in AI development, moving beyond prompt and context engineering to govern complex workflows where nodes represent specialized units of work. Effective graph design requires justifying each node's existence, using typed state schemas to prevent data rot, and employing deterministic routing to ensure system stability.
takeaways: A graph in AI engineering consists of nodes (units of work), edges (control flow), and state (shared data objects).
Graph engineering serves as a coordination layer across multiple agent loops, determining execution order and verification logic.
State rot is a major failure mode where incorrect data from one node flows through the system; it is mitigated by typed schemas and checkpoints.
Deterministic code-based routing is preferred over model-based routing to improve debuggability and reduce instability.
Reviewer nodes should use different models and fresh context to avoid the bias of agents 'grading their own homework'.
Multi-agent systems can consume significantly more tokens (up to 15x) than standard chat interactions, requiring strict budget caps.
Graphs should only be used when tasks require genuine specialties, parallel fan-out/join, or failure isolation.

sections.title: The anatomy of diffusion LLMs
sections.summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) represent a significant architectural shift from traditional autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel rather than sequentially. While autoregressive models are memory-bandwidth bound, dLLMs utilize masked diffusion and bidirectional attention to become compute-bound, better leveraging modern GPU efficiency. Recent advancements like LLaDA and Dream 7B show that these models are reaching performance parity with established autoregressive architectures on key benchmarks.
takeaways: Autoregressive models are structurally memory-bandwidth bound, requiring full weight loading for every single token generated.
Diffusion LLMs shift inference to being compute-bound by iteratively unmasking tokens in parallel using bidirectional attention.
LLaDA 8B matches LLaMA 3 performance on MMLU and exceeds it on TruthfulQA and HumanEval.
Pre-trained autoregressive models like LLaMA can be converted into diffusion models via attention mask annealing.
Block diffusion (BD3-LM) achieves perplexity within 0.5 points of autoregressive models on the LM1B dataset.
Inference acceleration for dLLMs is supported by stacks like Fast-dLLM and production serving tools like SGLang.

sections.title: Agent memory 和 state 並不是同一回事！
sections.summary: 本文釐清了 agent state 與 agent memory 之間的區別，指出 state 負責追蹤當前任務進度，而 memory 則儲存長期知識。為了確保可靠性，agent 應使用 checkpoint 在中斷後恢復 state，並使用 scoped memory 避免不同 agent 之間的發現互相污染。這些原則構成了一套「Agent Harness」基準，用於使用 CrewAI 等框架構建穩健的 AI workflow。
takeaways: State 專屬於當前的單次 run，並追蹤 agent 正在處理的內容及其所發現的資訊。
Memory 則會在多次 run 之間持久保存，作為值得保留的事實與經驗教訓。
在每個完成的步驟後進行 checkpointing，能讓 agent 在流程失敗時從最後的位置恢復執行。
Memory 應該針對每個 agent 劃分 scope，以防止 agent 錯誤採用來自其他 agent 的發現。
Agent Harness 基準包含將 memory 與 state 分離、對 memory 劃分 scope，並透過 checkpoint 實現 resume/fork 功能。
CrewAI 是一套開源框架，非常適合用於實現這些 agentic 架構模式。

sections.title: Graph engineering 完整解析
sections.summary: Graph engineering 是 multi-agent 系統的協調層，負責管理多個 autonomous loop 如何透過 node、edge 與 shared state 進行互動。它代表了 AI 開發的最新演進，超越了 prompt 和 context engineering，用於治理複雜的 workflow，其中 node 代表專門的工作單元。有效的 graph 設計需要確保每個 node 的存在都有其合理依據、使用 typed state schema 來防止 data rot，並採用 deterministic routing 來確保系統穩定性。
takeaways: AI engineering 中的 graph 由 node（工作單元）、edge（控制流）與 state（共用資料物件）組成。
Graph engineering 作為跨多個 agent loop 的協調層，負責決定執行順序與驗證邏輯。
State rot 是一種主要的 failure mode，即來自某個 node 的錯誤資料在系統中流竄；這可以透過 typed schema 和 checkpoint 來緩解。
相較於 model-based routing，更推薦使用基於程式碼的 deterministic routing，以提升 debuggability 並減少不穩定性。
Reviewer node 應使用不同的 model 與全新的 context，以避免 agent「自己改自己作業」的偏誤。
Multi-agent 系統消耗的 token 可能遠多於標準對話互動（最高達 15 倍），因此需要嚴格的 budget cap。
Graph 僅應在任務確實需要專業分工、平行 fan-out/join 或 failure isolation 時使用。

sections.title: Diffusion LLMs 架構剖析
sections.summary: Diffusion Large Language Models（dLLMs）代表了與傳統 autoregressive 模型相比的重大架構轉變，它以平行而非循序方式生成 token。Autoregressive 模型受限於記憶體頻寬（memory-bandwidth bound），而 dLLMs 則利用 masked diffusion 與 bidirectional attention 轉變為運算密集型（compute-bound），更能充分發揮現代 GPU 的效率。如 LLaDA 與 Dream 7B 等最新進展顯示，這些模型在關鍵 benchmark 上正逐步追平既有的 autoregressive 架構。
takeaways: Autoregressive 模型在結構上屬於 memory-bandwidth bound，每生成一個 token 都需要載入完整的 weight。
Diffusion LLMs 透過使用 bidirectional attention 平行反覆 unmask token，將推論轉變為 compute-bound。
LLaDA 8B 在 MMLU 上的表現媲美 LLaMA 3，並在 TruthfulQA 與 HumanEval 上超越了它。
像 LLaMA 這類 pre-trained autoregressive models 可以透過 attention mask annealing 轉換為 diffusion models。
Block diffusion (BD3-LM) 在 LM1B dataset 上的 perplexity 與 autoregressive models 相比差距在 0.5 點以內。
dLLMs 的 inference acceleration 受到如 Fast-dLLM 等 stack 與 SGLang 等 production serving tools 的支援。

items.title: 11 LLM Evaluation Methods

sections.title: Delta attention in Kimi K3 to fix growing KV cache
sections.summary: Kimi K3 utilizes a novel mechanism called delta attention to manage context windows of up to a million tokens without the memory overhead of a standard KV cache. Unlike traditional attention that stores every key-value pair in a growing list, delta attention compresses history into a fixed-size matrix using a delta rule to update associations. This approach reduces the computational cost from quadratic to linear by writing only the difference between new data and existing memory. To balance efficiency with accuracy, production models interleave these linear delta attention layers with standard full-attention layers.
takeaways: Delta attention replaces the growing KV cache with a fixed-size matrix to prevent memory exhaustion in long-context sequences.
The delta rule updates memory by reading the current state and writing only the 'delta' or difference between the guess and the target value.
Standard attention scales quadratically with sequence length, while delta attention scales linearly.
Fixed-size matrices in delta attention allow old entries to fade over time to accommodate new information.
Because compressed matrices result in approximate recall, Kimi K3 interleaves delta attention with standard attention layers for exact lookup where needed.

sections.title: 11 LLM evaluation methods
sections.summary: LLM evaluation is a fragmented field because different metrics encode varying assumptions about correctness, ranging from n-gram overlap to semantic similarity. Traditional metrics like BLEU and ROUGE are being supplemented by model-based approaches such as G-Eval and LLM-as-Judge to handle paraphrasing and subjective criteria. Specialized evaluation methods also exist for agentic trajectories, multi-turn conversations, and safety gating. Tools like Comet Opik provide an integrated platform to implement these diverse metrics for production observability.
takeaways: BLEU and ROUGE are n-gram based metrics that often fail to account for valid paraphrasing, making them unsuitable for creative generation.
BERTScore addresses the paraphrase problem by using token embeddings to measure semantic similarity rather than exact word matches.
Model-based evaluation (LLM-as-Judge) requires controls for length bias and position bias to ensure objective results.
LLM juries utilize multiple model families to mitigate the inherent biases of a single judge model.
Safety evaluations should function as binary gates rather than being averaged into a general quality score to prevent shipping violations.
Trajectory accuracy is essential for agentic systems to ensure the model reaches the correct answer through a valid logical path.
Comet Opik is an open-source platform that implements many of these evaluation metrics for production data.

sections.title: Quantile regression
sections.summary: Quantile regression is a technique used to estimate specific percentiles of a target variable's distribution, providing more context than traditional point estimates like the mean. By applying a weighted loss function, models can be biased to predict different quantiles, such as the 25th or 75th percentiles, to capture best-case and worst-case scenarios. This approach is particularly effective for understanding the spread of data and can be implemented using optimization tools or specialized machine learning libraries.
takeaways: Traditional regression models like OLS typically estimate the mean value, which may not represent the full distribution of the outcome.
Quantile regression estimates the conditional percentiles of the response variable based on input features.
The method utilizes a parameterized loss function where a weight parameter 'w' determines the specific quantile being targeted.
A weight of w=0.5 in quantile regression corresponds to predicting the median of the distribution.
Scipy's minimize method can be used to find optimal parameters for the quantile loss objective function.
LightGBM natively supports quantile objective functions, making it suitable for tree-based quantile modeling.

sections.title: Kimi K3 中的 Delta attention 用以解決持續增長的 KV cache 問題
sections.summary: Kimi K3 利用一種稱為 delta attention 的新機制來管理高達 100 萬 tokens 的 context windows，且沒有標準 KV cache 的 memory overhead。與傳統將每個 key-value pair 儲存在不斷增長的清單中的 attention 不同，delta attention 使用 delta rule 更新關聯性，將歷史資訊壓縮成一個固定大小的 matrix。此方法僅寫入新資料與現有 memory 之間的差異，從而將 computational cost 從 quadratic 降低到 linear。為了兼顧效率與準確度，production models 會將這些 linear delta attention layers 與標準的 full-attention layers 進行交錯配置。
takeaways: Delta attention 以固定大小的 matrix 取代持續增長的 KV cache，以防止 long-context sequences 中的 memory exhaustion。
Delta rule 透過讀取當前 state 並僅寫入預測值與 target value 之間的「delta」或差值來更新 memory。
Standard attention 會隨 sequence length 呈 quadratic 增長，而 delta attention 則呈 linear 增長。
Delta attention 中的固定大小 matrices 允許舊 entries 隨時間淡化，以容納新資訊。
由於壓縮後的 matrices 會導致 approximate recall，Kimi K3 將 delta attention 與 standard attention layers 交錯配置，以便在需要時進行 exact lookup。

sections.title: 11 種 LLM evaluation methods
sections.summary: LLM evaluation 是一個碎片化的領域，因為不同的 metrics 對於正確性有不同的假設，範圍涵蓋從 n-gram overlap 到 semantic similarity。如 BLEU 和 ROUGE 等傳統 metrics 正在被 G-Eval 和 LLM-as-Judge 等 model-based 方法所補充，以處理 paraphrasing 與主觀標準。針對 agentic trajectories、multi-turn conversations 與 safety gating 也存在專門的 evaluation methods。Comet Opik 等工具提供了整合平台，可實作這些多樣化的 metrics 以實現 production observability。
takeaways: BLEU 和 ROUGE 是基於 n-gram 的 metrics，通常無法考慮到合理的 paraphrasing，因此不適合用於 creative generation。
BERTScore 透過使用 token embeddings 來衡量 semantic similarity，而非精確的文字匹配，從而解決了 paraphrase 的問題。
Model-based evaluation（LLM-as-Judge）需要針對 length bias 與 position bias 進行控制，以確保客觀的結果。
LLM juries 利用多個 model families 來減輕單一 judge model 的固有 bias。
Safety evaluations 應作為 binary gates 運作，而不是平均計入一般 quality score 中，以防止違反規範的模型被部署上線。
Trajectory accuracy 對於 agentic systems 至關重要，以確保模型透過有效的邏輯路徑得出正確答案。
Comet Opik 是一個 open-source 平台，為 production data 實作了許多上述的 evaluation metrics。

sections.title: Quantile regression
sections.summary: Quantile regression 是一種用於估算 target variable 分布中特定 percentiles 的技術，比 mean 等傳統 point estimates 提供更多 context。透過應用 weighted loss function，可以引導模型預測不同的 quantiles（例如第 25 或第 75 個 percentiles），以捕捉最佳與最差情況。這種方法對於理解資料的 spread 特別有效，並且可以使用 optimization tools 或專門的 machine learning libraries 來實作。
takeaways: 像 OLS 這類的傳統 regression models 通常估計的是平均值（mean value），這可能無法代表結果的完整分佈。
Quantile regression 根據 input features 來估計 response variable 的條件百分位數（conditional percentiles）。
該方法利用 parameterized loss function，其中權重參數 'w' 決定了目標鎖定的特定 quantile。
在 quantile regression 中，權重 w=0.5 對應於預測分佈的中位數（median）。
可以使用 Scipy 的 minimize 方法來尋找 quantile loss objective function 的最佳參數。
LightGBM 原生支援 quantile objective functions，使其非常適合用於 tree-based quantile modeling。

sections.title: Checkpoint any method automatically using CrewAI
sections.summary: CrewAI version 1.14 introduces a checkpointing feature to handle failures in long-running agent flows. This system automatically creates recovery points during method executions, allowing users to resume or fork processes without restarting from scratch. It includes an asynchronous TUI for browsing and managing these states with full lineage tracking. The update aims to reduce token consumption and improve the reliability of complex agent pipelines.
takeaways: CrewAI v1.14 introduces automatic checkpointing for agent flows to prevent token waste.
Recovery points are created based on specific events like method execution finishing.
Flows can be resumed or forked into new branches with full lineage tracking.
An async TUI allows users to browse, inspect, and manage checkpoints directly.
The checkpointing system requires no additional infrastructure to implement.

sections.title: 5 techniques to optimize LLMs in production
sections.summary: LLM token generation performance is primarily limited by memory bandwidth rather than raw compute power, which explains why hardware upgrades like moving from an A100 to an H100 may yield diminishing returns. To address this, developers use techniques such as Flash Attention, Paged Attention, and Continuous Batching to optimize data movement and GPU utilization. However, standard serving frameworks like vLLM often pre-allocate memory, preventing multiple models from sharing a single GPU efficiently. Superlinked's Open-Source Inference Engine (SIE) addresses this by enabling shared GPU memory and on-demand loading for pipelines involving multiple specialized models.
takeaways: LLM token generation is a memory-bandwidth problem where the GPU often sits idle waiting for data from HBM.
Flash Attention avoids quadratic memory growth by computing attention in on-chip SRAM using a tiling approach.
Paged Attention reduces KV cache memory waste from 60-80% to less than 4% by using fixed-size blocks and a block table.
Continuous batching prevents GPU idle time by inserting new requests into finished slots after every decode step.
Speculative decoding speeds up inference by using a small draft model to propose tokens that are verified in parallel by a larger model.
Kernel fusion reduces HBM read/writes by merging multiple operations into a single kernel that utilizes registers and SRAM.
Superlinked's SIE allows multiple models to share a single GPU's memory, solving the over-allocation issues common in vLLM and TEI.

sections.title: Fine-tune Ultralytics YOLO26 object detection model
sections.summary: This guide demonstrates the process of fine-tuning the YOLO26 object detection model using the Ultralytics framework. The workflow integrates Roboflow for dataset management and CometML for comprehensive experiment tracking and logging. YOLO26 is specifically noted for its ability to generate one-box-per-object predictions in a single pass, removing the requirement for Non-Maximum Suppression. The tutorial covers the entire pipeline from dataset acquisition and training to evaluation and real-time inference.
takeaways: YOLO26 eliminates the need for Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) by producing clean, one-box-per-object predictions.
The fine-tuning workflow utilizes Ultralytics for training, Roboflow for dataset hosting, and CometML for experiment tracking.
Roboflow provides a specific 'yolo26' export format that includes the necessary directory structure and data.yaml file for Ultralytics.
Model performance is evaluated using standard metrics including precision, recall, and mean Average Precision (mAP).
The Ultralytics Platform allows users to train and deploy 25 different YOLO26 model variants directly from a web browser.
Fine-tuning can be applied to custom datasets by swapping the dataset source and adjusting class names.

items.title: Karpathy Said Something You’ll Regret Ignoring

sections.title: Karpathy said something you’ll regret ignoring
sections.summary: Andrej Karpathy emphasizes that developers remain responsible for software quality even when using vibe coding or agentic engineering. A significant risk in RAG agents is mixed leakage, where a model combines retrieved context with its own parametric knowledge, often leading to ungrounded claims. To address this, the author used Google's Agents CLI and Claude Code to develop a custom evaluation rubric called corpus_abstention. This process identified a specific instruction causing ungrounded answers and improved the agent's performance from 19 of 33 to 30 of 33 by enforcing retrieval.
takeaways: Developers maintain full responsibility for software vulnerabilities even when using AI agents for vibe coding.
RAG failures frequently occur when retrieved context is incomplete, leading models to supplement with parametric knowledge.
Model outputs lack token-level labels to distinguish between retrieved context and internal weights.
The corpus_abstention rubric provides categorical verdicts to track specific failure modes like mixed leakage.
Instructions allowing models to skip lookups for simple questions can cause ungrounded responses.
Implementing mandatory retrieval for every question improved evaluation scores from 19 of 33 to 30 of 33.

sections.title: Are we ready for an agent-native memory system?
sections.summary: The article examines the necessity of agent-native memory systems that maintain facts across sessions and update dynamically. Research into twelve different systems reveals that reliability is primarily determined at write time, where data structure is established during extraction. Graph-based methods are found to be more effective than flat stores, which often suffer from 'hallucinations of the past' due to stale information. While structured systems are more computationally expensive, they provide a more robust framework that cannot be fixed simply by using larger language models.
takeaways: Reliability in agent memory systems is decided at write time, not query time.
Graph-based methods are more reliable under fact updates and cross-session reasoning.
Flat stores fail because they lack schemas, leading to generic nodes that hinder downstream filtering.
Append-only and freeform stores produce 'hallucinations of the past' by returning stale facts.
Increasing the size of the backbone LLM does not resolve architectural failures in memory pipelines.
Structured memory systems can be orders of magnitude slower per query than unstructured ones.
Graphiti is an open-source memory system by Zep that uses Pydantic ontologies for structured extraction.

sections.title: How do LLMs work?
sections.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) function by predicting the next word in a sequence using conditional probability based on previous context. During training, the model learns a high-dimensional probability distribution where the trained weights serve as parameters. To prevent repetitive and uncreative outputs, LLMs employ sampling techniques rather than always selecting the most probable token. This process is controlled by a temperature parameter that adjusts the softmax function to balance between deterministic and stochastic generation.
takeaways: LLMs predict the next token by calculating the conditional probability P(A|B) for all possible next words given the preceding context.
The trained weights of an LLM represent the parameters of a high-dimensional probability distribution over sequences.
Greedy decoding (always picking the highest probability token) leads to repetitive and less useful model outputs.
Temperature is a hyperparameter that modifies the softmax function to influence the randomness of token sampling.
Low temperature values result in nearly greedy generation, while high temperature values produce more diverse and random outputs.
Advanced LLM architectures like Llama 4 utilize components such as Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE), sparse routing, and RMSNorm.

sections.title: LLMs 是如何運作的？
sections.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) 的運作方式是根據先前的 context，利用條件機率預測序列中的下一個 word。在 training 期間，模型會學習高維度的機率分佈，訓練好的 weights 即為其 parameters。為了防止重複且缺乏創意的輸出，LLMs 採用 sampling 技術，而非總是選擇機率最高的 token。此過程由 temperature 參數控制，透過調整 softmax 函數在 deterministic 與 stochastic 生成之間取得平衡。
takeaways: LLMs 透過在給定前文 context 的情況下，計算所有可能接續詞的條件機率 P(A|B) 來預測下一個 token。
LLM 訓練好的 weights 代表了序列上高維機率分佈的 parameters。
Greedy decoding（總是挑選機率最高的 token）會導致模型輸出重複且實用性較低。
Temperature 是一個 hyperparameter，它透過修改 softmax 函數來影響 token sampling 的隨機性。
較低的 temperature 值會導致接近 greedy 的生成，而較高的 temperature 值則會產生更多樣化且隨機的輸出。
像 Llama 4 這樣的高階 LLM 架構採用了 Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE)、sparse routing 和 RMSNorm 等組件。

sections.title: 5 LLM Quantization Techniques
sections.summary: Quantization is a critical technique for reducing the memory footprint of large language models, enabling them to run on hardware with limited VRAM. The process involves mapping high-precision weights (FP16) to lower-bit integers (INT4 or INT8), but naive rounding is often disrupted by outlier features present in models larger than 6.7B parameters. Five primary methods—RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, LLM.int8(), and QAT—offer different strategies for managing these outliers during rounding, inference, or training to maintain model accuracy.
takeaways: A 70B parameter model in FP16 requires 140GB of VRAM, which exceeds the capacity of a single H100 GPU.
Models larger than 6.7B parameters develop outlier dimensions with values 20x to 100x larger than average, which can break standard quantization.
GPTQ reduces rounding error by using calibration data to adjust remaining weights during the quantization process.
AWQ protects important weights by scaling them before rounding and is widely used in serving engines like vLLM.
LLM.int8() handles outliers by running them in FP16 while processing 99.9% of other values in INT8.
Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) simulates quantization damage during fine-tuning to let the model adapt its weights accordingly.
Google's Gemma 3 QAT checkpoints demonstrate that 4-bit models can maintain near full-precision quality with 3x lower memory.

sections.title: Layers of observability in AI systems
sections.summary: AI systems require observability practices similar to traditional software, utilizing traces and spans to monitor internal pipeline steps. In a RAG pipeline, individual spans track specific operations like embedding, retrieval, and generation to capture metrics such as latency, token counts, and costs. A unique Trace ID links these spans together, providing a complete view of a single request's journey. This granular visibility is essential for debugging failures, tracking expenses, and identifying performance drift in production LLM applications.
takeaways: Observability in AI systems is modeled using Traces for the entire request journey and Spans for individual operations.
A standard RAG pipeline consists of Query, Embedding, Retrieval, Context, and Generation spans.
Retrieval spans are critical for identifying issues like bad chunks, low relevance scores, or incorrect top-k values.
Generation spans are typically the most expensive and time-consuming, requiring tracking of input/output tokens and latency.
Trace IDs are used to link multiple spans to a single user request for end-to-end debugging.
Span-level metrics allow developers to catch model drift and tune individual components independently.
Opik is an open-source tool that implements these LLM observability and tracing standards.

sections.title: 5 種 LLM Quantization 技術
sections.summary: Quantization 是降低大型語言模型 memory footprint 的關鍵技術，使其能在 VRAM 有限的硬體上運作。該過程涉及將高精度權重（FP16）映射至較低位元的整數（INT4 或 INT8），但單純的 rounding 往往會受到 6.7B 參數以上模型中出現的 outlier features 干擾。五種主要方法——RTN、GPTQ、AWQ、LLM.int8() 與 QAT——提供了不同的策略，可在 rounding、inference 或 training 期間處理這些 outlier，以維持模型精確度。
takeaways: 一個採 FP16 的 70B 參數模型需要 140GB 的 VRAM，這已超過單張 H100 GPU 的容量。
大於 6.7B 參數的模型會產生數值比平均值大 20 到 100 倍的 outlier dimensions，這可能會破壞標準 quantization。
GPTQ 透過在 quantization 過程中利用 calibration data 調整其餘權重，以減少 rounding error。
AWQ 在 rounding 前透過縮放來保護重要權重，並廣泛應用於如 vLLM 等 serving engines。
LLM.int8() 處理 outlier 的方式是將它們以 FP16 執行，同時以 INT8 處理其餘 99.9% 的數值。
Quantization-Aware Training（QAT）在 fine-tuning 期間模擬 quantization 造成的損失，讓模型相應地調整其權重。
Google 的 Gemma 3 QAT checkpoints 證明，4-bit 模型可以在記憶體需求降低 3 倍的情況下，維持接近 full-precision 的品質。

sections.title: AI 系統中的 observability 層次
sections.summary: AI 系統需要與傳統軟體類似的 observability 實踐，利用 traces 與 spans 來監控內部 pipeline 步驟。在 RAG pipeline 中，個別 span 會追蹤特定操作，例如 embedding、retrieval 與 generation，以擷取 latency、token 數量與成本等指標。一個獨一無二的 Trace ID 會將這些 spans 串聯在一起，提供單一 request 完整流程的全貌。這種細粒度的可視性對於在 production 環境中的 LLM 應用程式排查錯誤、追蹤支出以及識別 performance drift 至關重要。
takeaways: AI 系統中的 observability 建模方式為：使用 Traces 代表整個 request 流程，並以 Spans 代表個別操作。
一個標準的 RAG pipeline 由 Query、Embedding、Retrieval、Context 與 Generation 等 spans 組成。
Retrieval spans 對於識別 bad chunks、低相關性分數或不正確的 top-k 值等問題至關重要。
Generation spans 通常成本最高且最耗時，需要追蹤 input/output tokens 與 latency。
Trace IDs 用於將多個 spans 連結至單一使用者 request，以進行端對端除錯。
Span 層級的指標讓開發者能夠及早發現 model drift，並獨立調校各個元件。
Opik 是一套實現這些 LLM observability 與 tracing 標準的開源工具。

sections.title: How do AI teams use RL in production?
sections.summary: The final chapter of the Reinforcement Learning course focuses on the practical application of RL concepts within the AI industry. It features case studies from companies like Cursor and Scale AI, demonstrating how theoretical frameworks map to production environments. The section emphasizes the transition from learning mechanics, such as PPO and GRPO, to analyzing real-world training pipelines and reward structures.
takeaways: Cursor utilizes a real-time RL loop to ship improved model checkpoints every five hours.
Scale AI demonstrated that a 4B parameter model could outperform GPT-5 on domain-specific tasks using RL.
Frontier labs are using verifiable rewards to develop reasoning and agentic capabilities in models.
A commercial market is emerging for the creation and sale of RL environments as standalone products.
The course covers a progression from foundations like MDPs and Bellman equations to advanced topics like RLHF and GRPO.
Understanding production RL requires identifying environment design, reward sources, and trajectory structures.

sections.title: LLM Routing vs Mixture of Agents
sections.summary: This section compares two architectural patterns for multi-LLM systems: LLM routing and Mixture of Agents (MoA). LLM routing optimizes for cost and latency by selecting a single best-fit model for a specific task using an intent classifier and cost ranker. Conversely, Mixture of Agents focuses on performance by aggregating independent outputs from multiple consulting models to produce a superior final response. Benchmarks like HermesBench show that MoA can significantly outperform individual models, while tools like Plano provide implementations for routing strategies.
takeaways: LLM routing selects one model to respond based on intent, latency, and price, leaving other models idle.
Mixture of Agents (MoA) uses multiple consulting models that analyze a query independently before an aggregator synthesizes the final answer.
In a MoA architecture, consulting models do not see each other's analysis; only the aggregator has access to all perspectives.
Nous Research reported that a MoA preset outperformed individual models on HermesBench by approximately 8% to 11%.
LLM routing and MoA are complementary tools: routing is for efficiency and model selection, while MoA is for maximizing capability.
Plano is a tool and GitHub repository designed to help implement LLM routing systems.

sections.title: Upgrading the HuggingFace fine-tuning skill
sections.summary: HuggingFace's fine-tuning skill for coding agents has been enhanced by integrating Bright Data's Web MCP to automate the data collection phase. Previously, the skill required a pre-existing dataset on the HuggingFace Hub, but the update allows agents to scrape data from platforms like Reddit and Amazon while bypassing anti-bot measures. The integrated workflow now covers the entire pipeline from web scraping and data formatting to model training and deployment. This enables users to initiate complex fine-tuning tasks using simple natural language instructions.
takeaways: HuggingFace's fine-tuning skill allows users to train open-source LLMs using plain English commands through coding agents like Claude.
The integration of Bright Data's Web MCP solves the limitation of requiring pre-existing datasets by enabling automated web scraping.
Bright Data's technology handles IP blocks, CAPTCHAs, and anti-bot systems across over 40 platforms.
The updated tool can automatically convert scraped content into instruction-response pairs for supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
The end-to-end process includes GPU selection, job monitoring, and pushing the final model to the HuggingFace Hub.

items.title: [Hands-on] Rebuilding Claude Code's Harness

sections.title: Rebuilding Claude Code's Harness
sections.summary: The article explains that the effectiveness of Claude Code lies in its harness—the surrounding code that manages planning, memory, and safety—rather than just the underlying model. The author demonstrates how to rebuild this architecture using CrewAI, an open-source framework that automates agent loops and delegation. Key components of a robust harness include sandboxed execution, persistent memory, and planning mechanisms to prevent context rot. While frameworks provide the structural layers, developers remain responsible for prompt engineering, tool selection, and environment setup.
takeaways: Claude Code's performance is primarily driven by its harness, which handles planning, tool execution, and memory.
CrewAI provides built-in features for agent orchestration, including hierarchical workflows and automated execution loops.
Context rot occurs when an agent's context window fills with irrelevant data, a problem mitigated by planning and reasoning layers.
Safety in autonomous agents requires sandboxed environments like E2B and human-in-the-loop approval systems.
Persistent memory and checkpointing allow agents to maintain state and learn from previous sessions using JSON or SQLite storage.
Frameworks reduce the engineering burden, but developers must still manage prompts, tool design, and execution environments.

CrewAI 為 agent orchestration 提供了內建功能，包括階層式 workflows 與 automated execution loops。
當 agent 的 context window 充滿無關資料時就會發生 context rot，這項問題可透過 planning 與 reasoning layers 來緩解。
自主 agent 的安全性需要像 E2B 這樣的 sandboxed environments 以及 human-in-the-loop 核准系統。
Persistent memory 與 checkpointing 讓 agent 能夠透過 JSON 或 SQLite 儲存來維持狀態，並從先前的 session 中學習。
Framework 能減輕工程負擔，但開發者仍必須管理 prompt、tool design 和執行環境。
